changes: New: how the Player Tier system works is now a proper Rules entry ('🏅 Player Tiers') instead of permanent on-screen text — accessible via a small 'ⓘ Tier badges' button right on the Casino leaderboard, an 'ⓘ How tiers work' button on the Badges screen, and from the main Rules hub alongside every game's own rules.
